asks: Does a subscription sign-in change how Silo reads traffic?
answer: No. Reading works the same way for both: the boundary ends the encrypted connection and reads the provider's format, whatever credential the request carries. A sign-in can change the host and the transport, though. Codex under a ChatGPT sign-in talks to chatgpt.com, and with an API key to api.openai.com. So the hosts Silo reads and their formats are listed per provider and per kind of sign-in, and a live check covers each pair.
